notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello and thanks to everyone who has played Line goes Up, if you want to report any bugs or give additional feedback you can join the Discord server or post in the Steam Comunity. After listening to the feedback provided, this first update aims to address the problem of players reaching game breaking amounts of money before completing the game. Future updates will fix crashes in those heights.



Added a Max amount for all upgrades that is removed upon seeing the credits

Added a victory notification that allows to start a new file, with the previous line remaining on the grid as a reminder of past victories

Fixed a bug that made it so the achievements remaining button didn’t update properly

Fixed a bug that made loading a line with multipliers not apply them correctly

Fixed a bug that prevented some visual feedback from appearing
